learn.hook: Stand tall in yoga. Your body makes a standing line!
points: In yoga, our body makes lines.
Tadasana (standing tall) makes a standing line.
Shavasana (lying flat on your back) makes a sleeping line.
In Trikonasana the legs spread wide and make slanting lines.
In Bhujangasana (cobra pose) the back bends and makes a curved line.

example.q: Which line does your body make in Shavasana?
steps: In Shavasana you lie flat on the mat.
Lying flat goes side to side, like the floor.

learn.reallife: On Yoga Day, 21 June, many schools do asanas together.

games.title: Sort the asanas
items: Tadasana
Vrikshasana (tree pose)
Shavasana
Makarasana (lying on the tummy)
Bhujangasana (cobra)
Dhanurasana (bow)
Chakrasana (wheel)

games.title: True or false?
items: In Tadasana the body makes a standing line
You stand straight up and down.
In Shavasana the body makes a slanting line
Lying flat makes a sleeping line.
In Trikonasana the legs make slanting lines
The legs spread apart and lean to the sides.
Bhujangasana makes a curved line with the back
The back bends up like a snake's hood.
Our body can only make straight lines
A bent back makes a curved line.

quiz.q: In Tadasana you stand straight and tall. What line does your body make?
quiz.explain: Standing straight goes up and down. That is a standing line.
steps: In Tadasana the body stands straight and tall.
Straight up and down = standing line.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up standing and sleeping lines

quiz.q: Ajay lies flat on his back in Shavasana. What line does his body make?
quiz.explain: Lying flat goes side to side, like the floor. That is a sleeping line.
steps: In Shavasana you lie flat on your back.
Flat, side to side, like the floor = sleeping line.
quiz.mistake: Thinks a lying body makes a standing line

quiz.q: In Trikonasana the legs spread wide apart. What lines do the legs make?
quiz.explain: Each leg leans to one side, so it makes a slanting line.
steps: In Trikonasana each leg leans to one side.
A leaning straight line = slanting line.
quiz.mistake: Thinks legs always make standing lines

quiz.q: In Bhujangasana (cobra pose) the back bends up. What line does the back make?
quiz.explain: A bent back is not straight. It makes a curved line.
steps: In cobra pose the back bends up.
A bent line is not straight.
So it makes a curved line.
quiz.mistake: Thinks every body line is straight

quiz.q: Which asana shows a sleeping line?
quiz.explain: In Shavasana you lie flat, making a sleeping line.
steps: Tadasana is standing; Trikonasana is slanting. Answer: Shavasana
quiz.mistake: Picks a standing pose

quiz.q: Neha stretches both arms straight up over her head. What line do her arms make?
quiz.explain: Arms straight up go up and down, a standing line.
steps: Arms go straight up over the head.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up up-down and side-to-side

teach.ask: Gappu: What lines does my body make in yoga?
teach.praise: Wow! Standing, sleeping, slanting and curved lines, all with your body!
teach.nudge: What line do I make when I lie down? And when I bend my back?

revise.summary: In yoga, our body makes lines. Tadasana makes a standing line, Shavasana a sleeping line, Trikonasana slanting lines and Bhujangasana a curved line.
focus: Name the line each asana makes.
Tell up-down (standing) from side-to-side (sleeping).
Spot slanting and curved body lines.
remember: Tadasana: standing line. Shavasana: sleeping line.
Trikonasana: slanting lines. Bhujangasana: curved line.
traps: A body lying flat makes a sleeping line, not a standing line.
Not every body line is straight. A bent back is curved.
Arms straight up make a standing line, not a sleeping line.

learn.hook: A flagpole stands up. A sleepy cat lies flat. A slide leans. Lines can do this too!
points: A sleeping line goes from left to right, like the floor. It is a horizontal line.
A standing line goes up and down, like a flagpole. It is a vertical line.
A slanting line leans to one side, like a slide in the park.
The letter H has 2 standing lines and 1 sleeping line.

example.q: Look at the letter A. What lines does it have?
steps: The two sides lean in. They are 2 slanting lines.
The middle line lies flat. It is 1 sleeping line.

learn.reallife: The legs of a table are standing lines. The table top is a sleeping line. A slide is slanting.

games.title: Stand, sleep or slant?
items: Flagpole
Tree trunk
Pillar of a house
Floor
Top of a table
Slide in the park
Ladder leaning on a wall

games.title: Match the letter to its lines

quiz.q: A flagpole is a ___ line.
quiz.explain: A flagpole goes straight up and down. That is a standing line.
steps: A flagpole goes straight up and down.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up standing and sleeping lines

quiz.q: Which line is like the floor of your room?
quiz.explain: The floor lies flat from left to right. That is a sleeping line.
steps: The floor lies flat from left to right.
Flat, side to side = sleeping line.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up standing and sleeping lines

quiz.q: A slide in the park is a ___ line.
quiz.explain: A slide leans to one side. It is not straight up and not flat. So it is slanting.
steps: A slide leans to one side.
So it is a slanting line.
quiz.mistake: Thinks a line can only stand or sleep

quiz.q: How many standing lines are in the letter H?
quiz.explain: H has a standing line on the left and one on the right. The middle line is sleeping.
quiz.mistake: Counts the sleeping middle line too

quiz.q: How many slanting lines are in the letter W?
quiz.explain: W goes down, up, down, up. Each part leans. That is 4 slanting lines.
quiz.mistake: Thinks W is made of 2 lines like V

quiz.q: Which letter has only standing and sleeping lines?
quiz.explain: L has 1 standing line and 1 sleeping line. A, V and X have slanting lines.
steps: A, V and X have slanting lines.
quiz.mistake: Does not notice the leaning lines in A, V and X

teach.ask: Gappu: What is a standing line? A sleeping line? And a slanting line?
teach.praise: Wow! Standing goes up and down, sleeping lies flat, and slanting leans. Perfect!
teach.nudge: Which line goes up like a flagpole? Which one lies flat? Which one leans?

revise.summary: A sleeping (horizontal) line goes left to right like the floor, a standing (vertical) line goes up and down like a flagpole, and a slanting line leans to one side.
focus: Name standing, sleeping and slanting lines.
Count each kind of line in a letter.
Find these lines around us.
remember: Sleeping line = horizontal. Standing line = vertical.
A slanting line leans to one side.
H has 2 standing lines and 1 sleeping line.
traps: Don't mix up standing and sleeping lines.
A line can also be slanting, not only standing or sleeping.
W has 4 slanting lines, not 2.

learn.hook: Draw a line with a ruler. Now draw a rainbow. Are they the same?
points: A straight line does not bend. It goes the same way all along.
A curved line bends, like a rainbow or a smile.
We draw straight lines with a ruler.
Some letters have both kinds. The letter D has 1 straight line and 1 curved line.

example.q: How many straight lines and curved lines are in the letter D?
steps: The left side of D does not bend. That is 1 straight line.
The right side bends round. That is 1 curved line.

learn.reallife: The edge of a ruler is straight. A bangle and the rim of a plate are curved.

games.title: Straight or curved?
items: Edge of a ruler
Edge of a book
Side of a door
Pencil
Rainbow
Bangle
Banana
Rim of a cup

games.title: True or false?
items: A rainbow looks like a curved line.
A rainbow bends like a big arch.
We use a ruler to draw a curved line.
A ruler helps us draw straight lines.
The letter O has no straight line.
O is one round curved line.
The letter L has a curved line.
L has 2 straight lines and no curve.
The letter D has a straight line and a curved line.
Its left side is straight and its right side is curved.

quiz.q: Which letter has only straight lines?
quiz.explain: T is made of 2 straight lines. O, C and S are curved.
steps: O, C and S bend: curved lines.
T is made of 2 straight lines.
quiz.mistake: Does not look for bends in the letters

quiz.q: How many straight lines are in the letter T?
quiz.explain: T has 1 line on top and 1 line going down. That is 2 lines.
quiz.mistake: Counts only the line going down

quiz.q: Which shape is made of only one curved line?
quiz.explain: A circle is one round line that bends all the way. It has no straight lines.
steps: Square and triangle have straight sides.
A circle is one round line that bends all the way.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up shapes with straight sides and round shapes

quiz.q: How many straight lines are in the letter E?
quiz.explain: E has 1 standing line on the left and 3 short lines going right. 1 + 3 = 4.
quiz.mistake: Forgets the standing line on the left

quiz.q: Meena draws a smile on a face. What kind of line is a smile?
quiz.explain: A smile bends like a little bowl. So it is a curved line.
steps: A smile bends like a little bowl.
quiz.mistake: Thinks every line is straight

quiz.q: How many curved lines are in the letter B?
quiz.explain: B has 1 straight line and 2 round bumps. Each bump is a curved line.
quiz.mistake: Counts the two bumps as one curve

teach.ask: Gappu: What is the difference between a straight line and a curved line?
teach.praise: I get it! A straight line does not bend. A curved line bends like a rainbow.
teach.nudge: Which line bends? Which line can I draw with a ruler?

revise.summary: A straight line does not bend, but a curved line bends like a rainbow or a smile. Some letters, like D, have both kinds.
focus: Tell straight lines from curved lines.
Count straight and curved lines in letters.
Know which shapes are made of curved lines.
remember: We draw straight lines with a ruler.
D has 1 straight line and 1 curved line.
A circle is one curved line.
traps: Don't forget the standing line on the left of E. E has 4 straight lines.
B has 2 curved lines, not one.
Not every line is straight. A smile is curved.

topics.title: Join the dots and trace the lines

learn.hook: Dot, dot, dot! Join them with lines and a house appears!
points: Join 4 dots with straight lines to make a square or a rectangle.
A house is a square with 2 slanting lines on top for the roof.
Curved lines make clouds, rainbows and smiles.
If a picture has a missing line, check which kind is missing: standing, sleeping, slanting or curved.

example.q: How many straight lines do you need for a house: a square with a triangle roof on top?
steps: Roof: 2 slanting lines. The top of the square is the roof's base.

learn.reallife: Dot-to-dot puzzles in activity books make pictures by joining dots.

items.q: Lines to join 4 dots in a square

quiz.q: Pari joins 4 dots to make a square. How many straight lines does she draw?
quiz.explain: A square has 4 sides, so she draws 4 lines.
steps: Each side is one straight line.
quiz.mistake: Counts the dots and the lines together

quiz.q: Om draws a square and puts 2 slanting lines on top for a roof. How many lines in all?
quiz.explain: 4 lines for the square and 2 for the roof. 4 + 2 = 6.
quiz.mistake: Forgets the roof lines

quiz.q: Which kind of line do we use to draw a rainbow?
quiz.explain: A rainbow bends like an arch, so it is a curved line.
steps: A rainbow bends like an arch.
quiz.mistake: Thinks a rainbow is made of straight lines

quiz.q: A picture of a door is missing its right side. Which line is missing?
quiz.explain: The side of a door goes up and down. It is a standing line.
steps: The side of a door goes up and down.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up the side and the top of the door

quiz.q: A tent picture is missing one side of its roof. Which line should you trace?
quiz.explain: A tent roof leans to the side, so it is a slanting line.
steps: A tent roof leans to one side.
quiz.mistake: Thinks a roof line is curved

quiz.q: Riya draws a cloud with 5 bumps. Each bump is 1 curved line. How many curved lines?
quiz.explain: 5 bumps, each 1 curved line, make 5 curved lines.
quiz.mistake: Counts the whole cloud as one line

teach.ask: Gappu: How can I draw a house by joining dots?
teach.praise: Yes! A square with 2 slanting lines on top makes a house.
teach.nudge: Which lines make the walls? Which lines make the roof?

revise.summary: Join dots with straight lines to make shapes like a square or a house. Curved lines make clouds, rainbows and smiles.
focus: Count the straight lines in a dot-to-dot picture.
Find which kind of line is missing in a picture.
Count curved lines in a drawing.
remember: A house is a square with 2 slanting lines on top: 6 straight lines.
Check which kind is missing: standing, sleeping, slanting or curved.
traps: Don't count the dots with the lines.
Don't forget the roof lines.
A rainbow is curved, not straight.

learn.hook: A rangoli is full of lines! Straight, curved, standing and slanting. Let's count them.
points: A pattern repeats the same lines again and again.
A square has 4 straight lines: 2 standing and 2 sleeping.
A tent shape has 2 slanting lines and 1 sleeping line.
A circle is made of 1 curved line.

example.q: Arjun draws 3 squares that do not touch. How many straight lines?

learn.reallife: Rangoli, kite strings, window bars and railway tracks all show lines.

items.q: Straight lines in the letter L
Straight lines in the letter H
Curved lines in the letter O

quiz.q: Meena draws a square. How many sleeping lines does it have?
quiz.explain: The top and the bottom of a square are sleeping lines. The two sides are standing lines.
quiz.mistake: Counts all 4 sides as sleeping lines

quiz.q: Kabir draws 2 triangles that do not touch. How many straight lines in all?
quiz.explain: Each triangle has 3 straight lines. 3 + 3 = 6.
quiz.mistake: Counts the lines of only one triangle

quiz.q: Which pattern repeats a curved line?
quiz.explain: ( bends, so it is a curved line. | and — are straight.
quiz.mistake: Does not notice which mark bends

quiz.q: What comes next? / \ / \ / ___
quiz.explain: The lines take turns: /, then \. After / comes \.
quiz.mistake: Does not see that the two lines take turns

quiz.q: Joseph makes a rangoli with 4 circles. How many curved lines?
quiz.explain: Each circle is 1 curved line. 4 circles make 4 curved lines.
quiz.mistake: Thinks a circle has no lines

quiz.q: Aisha draws 2 squares and 1 triangle, none touching. How many straight lines?
quiz.explain: Squares: 4 + 4 = 8. Triangle: 3. 8 + 3 = 11.
quiz.mistake: Counts 4 lines for the triangle too

teach.ask: Gappu: How many straight lines are in a square? How do you count them?
teach.praise: Yes! A square has 4 straight sides. Count them: 1, 2, 3, 4!
teach.nudge: How many sides does a square have? Are they straight or curved?

revise.summary: A pattern repeats the same lines again and again. A square has 4 straight lines, a tent shape has 2 slanting and 1 sleeping line, and a circle is 1 curved line.
focus: Count lines in many shapes that do not touch.
Find what comes next in a line pattern.
Count standing and sleeping lines in a square.
remember: Tent shape: 2 slanting lines and 1 sleeping line.
traps: Don't count all 4 sides of a square as sleeping lines.
A triangle has 3 lines, not 4.
Count the lines of every shape, not just one.

topics.title: Designs with many lines and zig-zags

learn.hook: Zig, zag, zig, zag! Join slanting lines and make a lightning bolt.
points: A drawing can use two kinds of lines, like standing and sleeping bars in a window.
A design can use three kinds, like a kite: slanting sides, a standing stick and a curved tail.
Some designs use all kinds: standing, sleeping, slanting and curved.
A zig-zag line is made by joining slanting lines, one up and one down.

example.q: A zig-zag goes up, down, up, down. How many slanting lines does it have?
steps: Each up is 1 slanting line. Each down is 1 slanting line.

learn.reallife: Zig-zag borders appear on sarees, and mountain roads often zig-zag up the hill.

games.title: Kinds of lines
items: Zig-zag
Window grill
Letter W
Ladder
Rainbow and sun
Smiling face
Kite with a curly tail
Letter S

games.title: True or false?
items: A zig-zag line is made of slanting lines
It goes up and down with slanting lines.
A zig-zag has curved lines
Zig-zag lines are straight and slanting.
A window with bars uses standing and sleeping lines
The bars go up-down and side to side.
A picture with a sun, a hut and a road can use all kinds of lines
Sun curved, roof slanting, walls standing, road sleeping.
The letter W is a zig-zag of 4 slanting lines
W goes down, up, down, up.

quiz.q: What is a zig-zag line made of?
quiz.explain: A zig-zag joins slanting lines, one going up and the next going down.
steps: A zig-zag goes up, then down, then up.
Each part is a slanting line.
So it is slanting lines joined together.
quiz.mistake: Thinks a zig-zag is wavy and curved

quiz.q: A zig-zag goes up, down, up, down, up, down. How many slanting lines?
quiz.explain: Each up and each down is one line. 2 + 2 + 2 = 6.
quiz.mistake: Counts only the ups

quiz.q: A window has standing bars and sleeping bars. How many kinds of lines does it use?
quiz.explain: Standing and sleeping: that is 2 kinds of lines.
steps: The bars are standing and sleeping.
quiz.mistake: Counts the bars instead of the kinds

quiz.q: Ali draws a hut with standing walls, a sleeping floor line and a slanting roof. Which line did he NOT use?
quiz.explain: He used standing, sleeping and slanting lines. No curved line.
steps: Walls = standing. Floor = sleeping. Roof = slanting.
So he did not use a curved line.
quiz.mistake: Does not check each kind of line

quiz.q: Which drawing uses a curved line?
quiz.explain: A rainbow is an arch, so it is curved. The others use straight lines only.
steps: A rainbow is an arch, so it bends.
Z, zig-zag and square window use straight lines.
Answer: A rainbow over a hill
quiz.mistake: Thinks a zig-zag is curved

quiz.q: Gauri draws 2 zig-zags. Each zig-zag has 4 slanting lines. How many slanting lines in all?
quiz.explain: 4 + 4 = 8 slanting lines.
quiz.mistake: Counts only one zig-zag

teach.ask: Gappu: How do I draw a zig-zag line?
teach.praise: Yes! Join slanting lines going up and down, again and again.
teach.nudge: What kind of lines make a zig-zag? How do I join them?

revise.summary: A design can use two, three or all kinds of lines. A zig-zag line is made by joining slanting lines, one up and one down.
focus: Count the slanting lines in a zig-zag.
Count how many kinds of lines a design uses.
Find which kind of line is not used.
remember: A zig-zag joins slanting lines, one up and one down.
Kinds of lines: standing, sleeping, slanting and curved.
traps: A zig-zag is not curved. It is made of slanting lines.
Count both the ups and the downs.
Count the kinds of lines, not the bars.

learn.hook: Fold a paper and open it. Look! A straight line, made without a ruler!
points: A fold in paper makes a crease. A crease is a straight line.
Fold again to make more creases. Each new fold gives one more line.
Some creases are standing or sleeping lines. Some are slanting.
Can a flat fold make a curved line? Try it! A flat fold always makes a straight line.

example.q: Fold a paper in half, then in half again the other way. Open it. How many creases?

learn.reallife: Paper boats and paper fans are made with many folds and creases.

items.text: A flat fold makes a ___ line
The line made by a fold is called a ___
Fold corner to corner and the crease is ___
Fold the top edge down to the bottom edge and the crease is ___
Fold the left edge to the right edge and the crease is ___

games.title: True or false?
items: A crease made by folding is a straight line
A flat fold always makes a straight crease.
Folding paper flat can make a curved crease
A flat fold always makes a straight crease.
More folds make more creases
Each new fold adds a crease.
Folding a square corner to corner makes a slanting crease
The crease goes from corner to corner, leaning.
A crease goes round like a circle
A crease is a straight line.

quiz.q: What kind of line does a flat fold in paper make?
quiz.explain: When you press a fold flat, the crease is a straight line.
quiz.mistake: Thinks folds can bend

quiz.q: Bina folds a paper top edge to bottom edge and opens it. What kind of crease does she see?
quiz.explain: The crease goes from side to side across the paper. That is a sleeping line.
steps: Top edge to bottom edge: the crease goes side to side.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up sleeping and standing lines

quiz.q: Kabir folds a square paper corner to corner. What kind of crease does he get?
quiz.explain: A corner-to-corner crease leans across the square. It is slanting.
steps: Corner to corner: the crease leans across.
quiz.mistake: Thinks every crease is sleeping

quiz.q: Lila folds a paper 3 times, each time in a new place, opening it after each fold. How many creases?
quiz.explain: Each fold makes 1 crease. 3 folds make 3 creases.
quiz.mistake: Counts only the last fold

quiz.q: In a folding game, Raj makes 5 creases and Tanu makes 7. How many more creases did Tanu make?
quiz.explain: 7 - 5 = 2. Tanu made 2 more creases.
quiz.mistake: Adds instead of finding the difference

quiz.q: Can you make a curved crease by folding paper flat?
options: No, a flat fold makes a straight line
quiz.explain: However you fold it flat, the crease is always straight.
steps: A flat fold always makes a straight crease.
So we cannot get a curved crease this way.
Answer: No, a flat fold makes a straight line
quiz.mistake: Thinks a crease can curve

teach.ask: Gappu: What line do I get when I fold paper?
teach.praise: Yes! A flat fold makes a straight crease line.
teach.nudge: Is the crease straight or curved?

revise.summary: A fold in paper makes a crease, and a crease is a straight line. Each new fold gives one more line.
focus: Count creases after folding.
Name the kind of crease: standing, sleeping or slanting.
Know that a flat fold cannot make a curve.
remember: A crease is a straight line.
Each new fold gives one more crease.
A flat fold always makes a straight line.
traps: A flat fold never makes a curved crease.
Don't count only the last fold.
A corner-to-corner crease is slanting, not sleeping.
